Test control from 03 Phase 5 A2. Only 04's compare rule, case_runs and control changed; input.json, expected.json and cases 01, 02, 03, 05 are byte-identical to approved. compare_note: parts = speechParts(reply, lang) (server/tts.js, the producer the page reads from, as FX-013); each part -> POST /api/speak {text, lang} in order, the next sent after the previous answered (unless the case says 'queued'). voice_used = the `voice` field of the server's tts_done log line for that part (03 DES-041 step 4: the voice the reader reports it used). all_parts_audio = every POST /api/speak of the case answered 200 audio/wav. voice_used_all = the one voice every part of the case (or reply) reported; any other or null value fails. profile_voice = GET /api/profile .voice. pitch_lower_than_serena[lang] = median F0 of the uncle-fu run < median F0 of the serena control run for that reply, F0 per 40 ms frame (10 ms hop) by normalised autocorrelation on the 24 kHz PCM, searched 60-400 Hz, a frame voiced when the peak >= 0.5, median over the voiced frames of all its parts. 04 (round 4, Q33): the case's steps run 3 times, each from a new LITTLEBUDDY_DATA_DIR and a new start (so reply 1 is a fresh switch from warm serena every time), under `control`; a run voided there is not one of the 3. save = the POST /api/profile response status and body .voice: 200/dylan when every run gives that, else the first run's value that differs. timeouts = parts answered 504 timeout or not answered, summed over the 3 runs. voice_used_all of a reply = the one voice every part of that reply reported in all 3 runs. first_sound_ok: reply 1 = first_sound_ms <= 8000 in every run (unchanged); replies 2 and 3 = the median of that reply's 3 first_sound_ms values <= 3000 (REQ-074 as amended by Q33).
pass: REQ-073: 01, 02, 03, 05 whole object exact. REQ-074: 04 whole object exact, built from 3 counted runs as compare_note says.

FX-026-04: Quiet machine (03 Phase 5 A2): while the case runs, no other gateway, test, mutation run or benchmark started by the run is running; an idle process the run did not start (the user's preview) is left untouched (Constitution §4.6), as in the architect's quiet measurements (log line 3).
After each start wait for GET /api/health ready true, not only tts true, before step 1's serena warm-up (03 Phase 5 A2).
Record per part, with first_sound_ms: the tts_done line's ms, queued_ms and audio_ms (03 Phase 5 A2).

Load rule (03 Phase 5 A2): when a reply's first_sound_ms in a run is over its limit (8000 reply 1, 3000 replies 2 and 3) and its first part's tts_done has ms > audio_ms, the run is load: it is voided, kept in the report with its numbers, and a fresh run replaces it. Over the limit with ms <= audio_ms is generation length and counts.
Default [unverified], not in A2: after 3 voided runs the case reports blocked (machine not quiet), never pass.
